items.title: T. Rowe Price Group (TROW) Keeps Bearish View On US Treasuries
items.summary: T. Rowe Price Group (NasdaqGS:TROW) keeps a bearish stance on US Treasuries while increasing exposure to UK government bonds. The allocation shift reflects the view that UK gilts currently offer a more attractive risk and return trade off than US debt. Fund managers are adjusting fixed income holdings in response to inflation pressures, geopolitical risks, and changing central bank policy paths.
